matrix.admission_note: Stock i286 omits SUPPORT_CRT31KHZ; crossed runs apply to supported classes only. This fixture mission does not enable that product feature.

requirements: stable cold-boot B_ref separate from runtime CPU base
freeze provider across each pair of guest status reads
only private time source may be controlled; never write result/GDC/PIC/CPU state
service while guest CPU is held must preserve complete CPU ledger
verify actual HLT before advancing wake time; port64 checkpoint alone is insufficient
honor pending SYNC work, old latched deadline and approved commit frontier
nanosecond anchor offsets use ceil(Q*1e9/(5*B_ref)); preserve sub-grid remainder
first valid anchor and diagnostic policy must be qualified separately
symbol presence alone does not authorize execution or PASS

phase_formula.semantics: right-continuous after service; no extra TURE_SYNC

cases.name: PROGRAMMED
cases.action: anchor stable display epoch after two settling frames; freeze
cases.expected: committed SYNC; bit5=0

cases.name: H_OUTSIDE
cases.expected: bit6=0

cases.name: H_BEFORE_ENTRY
cases.expected: bit6=0 at threshold equality

cases.name: H_INSIDE
cases.expected: bit6=1 at first inside quantum

cases.name: H_AFTER_EXIT
cases.expected: bit6=0 after modulo wraps

cases.name: LINE_BEFORE
cases.expected: bit6=1 before line boundary

cases.name: LINE_AFTER
cases.expected: bit6=0 after line boundary

cases.name: V_BEFORE
cases.expected: bit5=0; countdown uses display end

cases.name: V_ENTRY
cases.expected: bit5=1; recompute bit6 from latched V endpoint

cases.name: V_INSIDE
cases.expected: bit5=1; no TURE_SYNC double-toggle

cases.name: V_EXIT
cases.expected: bit5=0; pending unaccepted IRQ2 expires

cases.name: ONE_FRAME
cases.expected: same phase as one full frame earlier

cases.name: SEVERAL_FRAMES
cases.expected: three further frames; finite PIC state, no backlog

cases.name: HUGE_GAP
cases.expected: bounded finite transforms; no per-frame loop; host service-cost/model check

cases.name: CPU_WORK_BEFORE
cases.action: same Q as14, freeze through substantial guest CPU work
cases.expected: host CPU ledger before; reference phase fixed

cases.name: CPU_WORK_AFTER
cases.expected: guest progress delta32768; positive CPU ledger delta; exact phase/IRR unchanged

cases.name: CPU_HELD
cases.action: at 0x3010 hold CPU; advance D ticks through qualified service seam
cases.expected: byte-identical CPU ledger during service; bit5=1 and phase changes; then resume to sample

cases.name: IRQ_MASKED_PENDING
cases.action: after guest maskFF/port64 (0x3002), service next VSync at 0x1204
cases.expected: IMR2=1 IRR2=1 ISR2=0 accepted_count=0; A=0

cases.name: IRQ_MASKED_EXPIRED
cases.expected: IRR2=0 accepted_count=0 A=1; no queued periods

cases.name: IRQ_ACCEPTED_ISR
cases.action: at 0x3003 after guest unmask/port64, service next VSync; resume STI and normal acceptance
cases.expected: IMR2=0 IRR2=0 ISR2=1 accepted_count=1; no host delivery

cases.name: ISR_ACROSS_FRAME
cases.action: after guest port64 rearm (0x3004), honor two guest frame waits with IF=0
cases.expected: at least two VSyncs; ISR2=1 IRR2=0 count1 A=1

cases.name: EOI
cases.action: freeze across actual guest specific EOI
cases.expected: ISR2=0 count1; A unaffected by EOI

cases.name: HLT_WAKE
cases.action: 0x3005 announces STI/HLT; freeze until actual halted CPU verified; advance next VSync via qualified service
cases.expected: normal wake; count2; savedIP=post-HLT label CS2000 IF1; entry1111/wake2222

cases.name: HLT_EOI
cases.action: freeze across guest EOI and maskFF
cases.expected: ISR2=0 count2 EOI_count2; no extra acceptance

cases.name: FIFO_QUEUED
cases.action: freeze while guest enqueues slave PITCH parameter, read both status ports
cases.expected: capture FIFO pre-drain bits separately from phase/busy; no command-time conversion

cases.name: FIFO_DRAINED
cases.action: same fake time, next direct status reads
cases.expected: FIFO empty; unchanged bit5/6; busy remains separate

cases.name: SYNC_ALTERNATE
cases.action: after new master P4=old+1, follow latched old segment and assigned next commit then two frame waits
cases.expected: host confirms new SYNC/R/H/D/V; no premature reanchor; raw scan sample matches resulting phase

cases.name: SYNC_RESTORED
cases.action: restore original geometry; same commit sequencing
cases.expected: host confirms restored geometry and exact settled phase

additional_host_cases.action: repeat identical schedule with all host draw/presentation suppressed through future private adapter
additional_host_cases.expected: same structured phase/PIC/IRQ/progress result and committed state; latest presentation state separately qualified

additional_host_cases.action: repeat complete cold-boot runs; partition advances including sub-reference-quantum ns residues
additional_host_cases.expected: same final phase/remainder/finite IRQ as single advance; no premature boundary

additional_host_cases.action: variant schedule gives all seven checkpoints same frozen time
additional_host_cases.expected: same bit5/6 and finite IRQ despite guest CPU progress

additional_host_cases.action: repeat runs with monotone schedules sampling threshold/boundary tick-1,tick,tick+1; include F-1,F,F+1 and V-segment residue
additional_host_cases.expected: exact reference_phase for both ports; selected samples only

additional_host_cases.action: host/model follow-up: inject no waits from runner; observe approved configured memory charge selectors at same phase
additional_host_cases.expected: detailed charge qualification remains host/model work; N4 records phase/PIC/CPU context
